personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (Customized to user's requested Dark Navy / White palette)
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, immersive vertical video experience focused on fluidity, high-contrast typography, and minimal chrome.

spacing.rule: Use 8pt grid strictly. Edge padding is critical to avoid overlapping with right rail or bottom tabs.

do's: Use subtle drop shadows on text and icons over video for contrast without dark circle backgrounds.
Use vertical gradient scrims to ensure text readability over the video.
Use glass effects on the bottom sheet header/drag handle.
dont's: No solid dark circle backgrounds behind the right-rail action icons.
Do not blur the video itself except when the comments bottom sheet is active.

screens.name: Meditazioni
screens.purpose: A fluid, vertical swiping feed of short-form meditations (Reels style).

states.loading: Dark navy surface with a minimal white loading spinner in the center.
states.empty: No meditations available. Show a soft mic icon with a prompt to check back.

screens.layout:
1. Root container is 100vh with a FlatList/FlashList pagingEnabled vertically. 
2. Video Component takes absoluteFill of each cell. 
3. Layer 1 (Overlays): expo-linear-gradient at the bottom (transparent to 80% #050A18 from 50% down to 100%) and top (transparent to 60% #050A18 from 20% to 0%). 
4. Layer 2 (Right Action Rail): Positioned absolutely right: 8pt, bottom: ~100pt. Stack of icons (Heart, Chatbubble, Share) with vertical gap of 24pt. Icons MUST NOT have circular dark backgrounds—just white icons with text-shadow/drop-shadow (shadowColor: '#000', opacity: 0.5, radius: 2) and small text counters below them. 
5. Layer 3 (Bottom Info Block): Positioned absolutely left: 16pt, bottom: ~40pt, right: 80pt (to clear the action rail). Contains: Avatar + '🎙 Username' in a row, large Video Title below it, and italicized Bible Verse below that. All text needs drop-shadows. 
6. Layer 4 (Interactions): Wrap video in TapGestureHandler. Single tap: Play/Pause (shows a subtle pulsing play/pause icon in the center that fades out). Double tap: Like (triggers a heart burst animation in the center). 
7. Bottom Sheet: @gorhom/bottom-sheet for comments. When it slides up to ~55%, the video should dynamically scale/translate to occupy the top 45% (using Reanimated shared values).

meditation_video_cover.alt: Cinematic portrait of a man speaking into a microphone

instructions_to_main_agent: Reels/TikTok Feed Redesign: Strip out the heavy circular dark backgrounds behind the action icons on the right rail. This is the #1 thing that makes it look cheap. Use clean, white Ionicons with a subtle black drop shadow (shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: {width: 0, height: 1}, shadowOpacity: 0.6, shadowRadius: 3).

Gradient Scrims: Do not apply text-shadow to every piece of text if a gradient scrim does the job better. Use a 2-stop vertical expo-linear-gradient from 'transparent' at 0% to 'rgba(5, 10, 24, 0.85)' at 100% positioned absolutely at the bottom 40% of the screen. This ensures the title, verse, and speaker name are legible regardless of the video underneath.

Interaction Polish: Implement double-tap to like using 'react-native-gesture-handler' TapGestureHandler (numberOfTaps={2}). Play/Pause should use a separate TapGestureHandler (numberOfTaps={1}) that triggers a Reanimated fade-in/fade-out of a Play/Pause icon in the center of the screen.

Comments Bottom Sheet: Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet. As requested by the user, animate the video's container height or scale using Reanimated's useAnimatedStyle bound to the bottom sheet's animated index/position. When the sheet covers 55%, the video should smoothly compress/translate to fit the remaining 45% at the top.
Safe Area: Do not overlap the top title 'Meditazioni' with the OS status bar. Ensure the bottom text block stops at least 24pt above the bottom screen edge (or bottom tab bar if one exists).

Palette Override: The user explicitly requested a 'dark blue/white palette'. The strict 'no-blue' rule is overridden here by explicit user request. Use #050A18 for the base navy and white for primary text/icons.
